name: innostaas-repo-context
description: Read your GitHub code as context: sign in with a personal access token in a panel, pick a repo, then browse, read, and search that repo's files
long_description:
Adds an in-chat panel for pasting a GitHub personal access token, lists every repo that token can see, and lets you pick one as the active repo. From then on Claude can list the repo's file tree, read individual files, and search its code — so it can answer questions about a codebase that is not checked out locally.

The token is validated against GitHub and stored in this machine's OS keychain. It is never written into the conversation.

tools.name: connect_github_repo
tools.description: Open the panel to sign in with a GitHub token and pick the active repo

tools.name: github_repo_status
tools.description: Report sign-in state and which repo is active

tools.name: repo_overview
tools.description: Summarize the active repo: branch, languages, top-level layout, README

tools.name: list_repo_files
tools.description: List files and directories in the active repo

tools.name: read_repo_file
tools.description: Read one file from the active repo

tools.name: search_repo_code
tools.description: Search code in the active repo

tools.name: set_active_repo
tools.description: Set the active repo by name, without the panel

tools.name: github_disconnect
tools.description: Delete the stored token and clear the active repo
